products.name: Storm Shell Jacket
products.desc: The Storm Shell Jacket is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Storm Shell Jacket in forest green, front view
Model wearing the Storm Shell Jacket on a rainy coastline
Storm Shell Jacket chest zip and taped seams with raindrops

products.long_desc: Our most trusted shell for wet, wild days. Three-layer waterproof fabric with fully taped seams keeps sideways rain out, while pit zips dump heat on steep climbs. The helmet-compatible hood adjusts in three places and moves with your head.

specs.label: Features
specs.value: Pit zips, 2 chest pockets, adjustable hood

products.name: Ridge Down Jacket
products.desc: The Ridge Down Jacket is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Ridge Down Jacket in slate blue, front view
Man in the Ridge Down Jacket outside a mountain hut on a frosty morning
Ridge Down Jacket baffles and zip with frost

products.long_desc: Warmth without the bulk for cold mornings and long belays. Responsibly sourced 700-fill down sits in stitched baffles, and the water-repellent shell shrugs off light snow. It packs into its own pocket when the sun comes out.

specs.label: Features
specs.value: Insulated hood, packs into hand pocket

products.name: Trail Softshell
products.desc: The Trail Softshell is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Trail Softshell in sand, front view
Woman hiking a heather trail in the Trail Softshell
Trail Softshell collar, zip and chest pocket

products.long_desc: A stretchy, breathable layer for days that can't decide what they want to be. The softshell blocks wind and light showers while moving with you on scrambles. Clean styling means it works just as well in town.

specs.label: Features
specs.value: Chest pocket, 2 hand pockets, stand-up collar

products.name: Fjord Rain Jacket
products.desc: The Fjord Rain Jacket is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Fjord Rain Jacket in mustard yellow, front view
Man in the Fjord Rain Jacket on a jetty in the rain
Fjord Rain Jacket flap pocket and snap button in the rain

products.long_desc: A classic rain jacket built for fjord-side weather. The coated fabric is fully waterproof, the peaked hood keeps rain off your face, and big flap pockets hold maps and gloves. Simple, tough and made to be worn for years.

specs.label: Features
specs.value: Storm flap, 2 flap pockets, drawcord hem

products.name: Alpine Insulated Parka
products.desc: The Alpine Insulated Parka is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Alpine Insulated Parka in charcoal, front view
Woman in the Alpine Insulated Parka walking through a snowy forest
Alpine Insulated Parka fleece-lined hood and storm flap

products.long_desc: Our warmest jacket for real Nordic winters. A thigh-length cut, synthetic insulation that stays warm when damp and a fleece-lined hood keep the cold out on long, dark days. Comfortable down to around -25°C when active.

products.name: Breeze Wind Jacket
products.desc: The Breeze Wind Jacket is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Breeze Wind Jacket in pale grey-blue with its packing pouch
Runner on a windy coastal path in the Breeze Wind Jacket
Breeze Wind Jacket packed into its pouch in an open hand

products.long_desc: An ultralight windbreaker you'll forget is in your pack until you need it. The thin ripstop cuts the wind on exposed ridges and coastal paths, and the whole jacket stuffs into its own chest pocket. Ideal for running and fast hiking.

specs.label: Features
specs.value: Packs into kangaroo pocket, clip loop

products.name: Summit GTX Boot
products.desc: The Summit GTX Boot is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Summit GTX Boot in brown leather, side view
Summit GTX Boot on wet mossy granite
Summit GTX Boot lugged outsole

products.long_desc: A proper mountain boot for rough trails and heavy packs. Waxed nubuck leather and a waterproof membrane keep feet dry, while the stiff lugged sole grips on wet rock and scree. Built to be resoled, not replaced.

products.name: Trailrunner 3
products.desc: The Trailrunner 3 is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Trailrunner 3 in moss green, side view
Trailrunner 3 landing on a muddy forest trail
Trailrunner 3 lugged outsole

products.long_desc: A grippy, cushioned trail shoe for fast days in the hills. Aggressive 5 mm lugs bite into mud and loose ground, the breathable mesh dries quickly, and quick-pull laces mean no stopping to re-tie. Light enough for long runs.

products.name: Scree Approach Shoe
products.desc: The Scree Approach Shoe is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Scree Approach Shoe in stone-grey suede, side view
Scree Approach Shoe on a granite slab during a scramble
Scree Approach Shoe rubber toe cap and lace-to-toe lacing

products.long_desc: Made for the walk-in and the scramble. A sticky rubber toe and climbing-zone sole give confidence on slabs, while lace-to-toe lacing locks the fit for technical moves. Durable suede handles sharp granite.

products.name: Moss Hiking Boot
products.desc: The Moss Hiking Boot is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Moss Hiking Boot in olive suede, side view
Moss Hiking Boots on a boardwalk across an autumn bog
Moss Hiking Boot eyelets, collar and heel reinforcement

products.long_desc: An all-round hiking boot that feels broken in from day one. The suede and textile upper breathes on warm days, the waterproof lining handles boggy trails, and the cushioned midsole keeps long days comfortable.

products.name: Tundra Winter Boot
products.desc: The Tundra Winter Boot is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Tundra Winter Boot in dark brown with wool cuff, side view
Tundra Winter Boots in deep snow outside a cabin at dusk
Tundra Winter Boot wool cuff and speed hooks

products.long_desc: Keeps feet warm in deep snow and slush. A waterproof leather upper, rubber lower shell and wool-lined cuff seal out cold, while the deep winter outsole grips on packed snow. Comfortable down to around -30°C.

products.name: Camp Slip-On
products.desc: The Camp Slip-On is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Pair of Camp Slip-On shoes in slate grey quilting
Camp Slip-Ons by a campfire at a mountain lake
Camp Slip-On diamond quilting and fleece lining

products.long_desc: Warm, quilted camp shoes for evenings by the fire. Fold the heel down to slip them on and off at the tent, or wear them up for a short walk to the lake. They pack flat into their own stuff sack.

products.name: Daypack 22
products.desc: The Daypack 22 is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Daypack 22 in slate blue, three-quarter view
Woman carrying the Daypack 22 on a misty forest path
Daypack 22 opened to show the sleeve and organiser pocket

products.long_desc: A daypack that does everything well. The curved zip opens wide, a padded sleeve takes a laptop or water bladder, and a stretch mesh front pocket holds a wet layer. Comfortable from office commute to summit lunch.

products.name: Explorer 45
products.desc: The Explorer 45 is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Explorer 45 trekking pack in forest green, three-quarter view
Hiker with the Explorer 45 crossing a mountain stream
Explorer 45 back panel, harness and hip belt

products.long_desc: A versatile trekking pack for long weekends and hut-to-hut trips. The ventilated back panel keeps you cool, the padded hip belt carries the load, and the top lid keeps essentials close. Plenty of attachment points for poles and axe.

specs.label: Features
specs.value: Ventilated back, hip-belt pockets, ice-axe loop

products.name: Trek 65 Pack
products.desc: The Trek 65 Pack is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Trek 65 Pack in charcoal, three-quarter view
Woman with the Trek 65 Pack on an Arctic plateau
Trek 65 Pack front panel open with gear packed inside

products.long_desc: Our expedition pack for multi-day treks above the treeline. A floating lid, front U-zip access and a separate sleeping-bag compartment make packing simple, and the adjustable harness carries heavy loads comfortably.

specs.label: Features
specs.value: Front U-zip, sleeping-bag compartment, adjustable back

products.name: Commuter 18
products.desc: The Commuter 18 is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Commuter 18 roll-top in sand waxed canvas, three-quarter view
Man carrying the Commuter 18 along a rainy harbour street
Commuter 18 leather strap and brass buckle on waxed canvas

products.long_desc: A clean, roll-top backpack for city days and short trips. Waxed canvas ages beautifully and keeps the rain off, the leather strap and brass buckle close the top securely, and a slim padded sleeve protects your laptop.

products.name: Hydration Vest 8
products.desc: The Hydration Vest 8 is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Hydration Vest 8 in black and moss green with soft flasks
Trail runner wearing the Hydration Vest 8 on a ridge
Hydration Vest 8 flat-lay with flasks and running kit

products.long_desc: A close-fitting running vest that carries everything without bouncing. Two soft flasks sit in easy reach on your chest, stretch pockets hold gels and a phone, and the back pocket swallows a jacket. Comfortable for hours on the trail.

products.name: Duffel 60
products.desc: The Duffel 60 is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Duffel 60 in rust orange, three-quarter view
Duffel 60 being loaded into a car beside a fjord
Duffel 60 opened with packed clothes and boots

products.long_desc: A tough, weatherproof duffel for car trips, boats and base camps. The coated fabric shrugs off rain and dirt, the wide D-zip makes packing easy, and the padded strap turns it into a carry bag when needed.

specs.label: Features
specs.value: D-zip lid, removable strap, end pocket

products.name: Merino Beanie
products.desc: The Merino Beanie is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Merino Beanie in oatmeal rib knit
Man wearing the Merino Beanie by a frozen lake
Merino Beanie rib knit close-up on a wooden bench

products.long_desc: A soft merino beanie that stays warm and doesn't itch. The fine rib knit stretches to fit, and the folded cuff gives double warmth over the ears. Naturally odour-resistant, so it works for multi-day trips.

products.name: Trek Poles Pair
products.desc: The Trek Poles Pair is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Trek Poles Pair with cork grips, standing upright
Older hiker climbing a rocky trail with the Trek Poles
Trek Poles cork grip, wrist strap and flick-lock clamp

products.long_desc: Light, stiff carbon poles that save your knees on long descents. The natural cork grips mould to your hands, the flick-lock clamps adjust in seconds with gloves on, and they pack down small for travel.

products.name: Insulated Bottle 1L
products.desc: The Insulated Bottle 1L is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Insulated Bottle 1L in matte moss green
Insulated Bottle 1L on a lakeside rock at sunrise with hot tea
Insulated Bottle 1L cap, carry loop and carabiner

products.long_desc: Keeps coffee hot through a cold day, or water cold through a hot one. Double-wall vacuum insulation, a leak-proof cap and a carry loop that clips onto a pack. The tough powder coat doesn't mind being dropped.

products.name: Headlamp 400
products.desc: The Headlamp 400 is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Headlamp 400 in charcoal with grey headband
Woman reading a map by headlamp at a tent at night
Headlamp 400 with main beam and red LED lit at dusk

products.long_desc: A bright, compact headlamp for camp, early starts and night trails. The main beam reaches far down the path, the red mode keeps your night vision, and the rechargeable battery lasts all weekend on low.

products.name: Wool Hiking Socks
products.desc: The Wool Hiking Socks is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Wool Hiking Sock in stone grey with rust heel and toe
Hiker pulling on the Wool Hiking Socks on a mossy rock
Wool Hiking Sock cushioned terry footbed

products.long_desc: Merino socks with cushioning exactly where you need it. The terry-loop footbed softens long descents, the reinforced heel and toe last for seasons, and the wool keeps feet warm when wet and fresh for days.

products.name: Packable Gloves
products.desc: The Packable Gloves is built for Nordic conditions: durable, light and made to last season after season.

images.alt: Packable Gloves in black softshell, palm and back
Gloved hands adjusting a backpack strap on a mountain pass
Packable Gloves touchscreen fingertip on a phone

products.long_desc: Light, windproof gloves for shoulder seasons and high-output days. The grippy palm holds poles and rock, touchscreen fingertips let you check the map without taking them off, and they pack into a jacket pocket.
